system.description:
You conjure your lightning release chakra and mold it to form a defensive instrument of your choice.

When you would take damage, you gain +2 AC against the triggering attack and begin to build up retributive energy.

Each time you take damage until the end of the current turn you build up energy. Count the number of times you take damage from now, until the end of the current turn building up lightning with each instance.

At the end of the current turn, you discharge all of the built-up energy. All creatures within a 15-foot radius must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d6 lightning damage for each instance of damage counted or half as much on a successful save.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the bonus to AC, to +3. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher all creatures that fail their saving throw vs this jutsu also gain 2 ranks of Shocked.
